text: dsh-tdai-memory 是面向 DSH Web 和 Desktop 的分层记忆插件：它在会话结束时捕获真实用户与助手对话，交由记忆管线提取结构化事实、场景信息和用户画像，并在后续提示中按当前消息注入相关记忆。插件还提供长期记忆搜索和原始对话搜索两种 agent 工具，支持配置记忆目录、OpenAI 兼容的提取模型与 embedding 服务，以及捕获、提取、召回和工具开关。适合希望让 DSH 在不同会话间参考既有对话、偏好和事实的用户。首次使用需配置可用的提取 LLM 和 embedding endpoint；记忆数据默认保存在本机目录。

dsh-tdai-memory adds layered memory to DSH Web and Desktop. It captures turns, supports structured memory extraction, injects relevant context into later prompts, and provides tools to search memories and raw conversations. Configure compatible LLM and embedding services; data defaults locally.
想让 DSH 记住之前聊天里提到的偏好和事实。
有没有办法在新会话里自动带入相关的旧记忆？
我想按关键词找回以前和 agent 的对话内容。
能不能把历史对话整理成结构化的长期记忆？
I want my assistant to remember facts and preferences from earlier chats.
Can relevant memories be added to the prompt automatically each turn?
I need to search old conversation logs for an exact detail.
How can I keep a local memory store that works across DSH sessions?
dsh-tdai-memory 的功能「对话捕获与记忆提取」：在会话 flush 时选取最近一轮真实用户消息及助手回复，提交给分层记忆核心，供后续 L1 结构化提取。
dsh-tdai-memory 的功能「自动记忆召回」：组装系统提示时读取当前真实用户消息，查询相关记忆，并将召回内容及画像上下文追加到 prompt。
dsh-tdai-memory 的功能「长期记忆搜索」：agent 调用 tdai_memory_search 并提供 query，可选 limit，得到从历史对话提取的事实、偏好和经历。
dsh-tdai-memory 的功能「原始对话搜索」：agent 调用 tdai_conversation_search 并提供 query，可选 limit，查找过去的 L0 对话记录。
dsh-tdai-memory 的功能「记忆行为配置」：插件设置可控制数据目录、LLM 与 embedding endpoint，以及捕获、提取、自动召回和搜索工具开关。
dsh-tdai-memory 的功能「会话结束刷新」：在 one-shot/headless 模式下，会话 flush 后等待待处理的 L1 提取完成，退出清理时也会为已见会话执行最终刷新。
dsh-tdai-memory 使用前须知：提取和 embedding 需要可用的 OpenAI 兼容服务；默认 embedding 地址是本机 127.0.0.1:8088/v1，实际请求发送到用户配置的 endpoint。

dsh-tdai-memory README · DSH TDAI Memory：简体中文 | [English](README.en.md)

将 TencentDB Agent Memory 的分层记忆系统接入 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)：捕获对话、提取结构化记忆，并在后续对话中检索相关内容。项目基于原 OpenClaw 插件的核心进行 DSH 适配。

dsh-tdai-memory README · 功能：| 层级 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| L0 | 捕获原始对话，供后续检索 |
| L1 | 使用提取模型整理事实、偏好和事件等结构化记忆 |
| L2 / L3 | 生成场景信息与用户画像 |
| 召回与搜索 | 按当前消息召回相关记忆；提供 `tdai_memory_search` 和 `tdai_conversation_search` 工具 |

数据默认保存在 `~/.memory-tencentdb/memory-tdai`，可复用已有同目录记忆。记忆写入、提取和召回依赖启用状态、模型连接及检索结果，不保证每条信息都会被保存或召回。

dsh-tdai-memory README · 兼容性与安装：支持 DSH Web / Desktop；仓库声明兼容 `0.2.0-rc.2`、`0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2` / `rc.3` / `rc.4` / `rc.5` 和符合 `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0` 的版本，预发布版本范围见 [package.json](package.json)。要求 Node.js `>=22.18`。

Desktop 先在 **应用 → 管理 dsh 命令** 安装桌面版 `dsh`：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tdai-memory
```

Web 将 `desktop` 改为 `web`。安装后重启 DSH，打开 **插件 → 已安装 → dsh-tdai-memory**。也可通过 [Enhancement Suite](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-enhancement-suite) 安装。

dsh-tdai-memory README · 快速配置：1. 配置用于记忆提取的 **OpenAI 兼容 LLM 地址、模型和密钥**。
2. 配置 **OpenAI 兼容 Embedding 地址、模型和维度**。默认地址 `http://127.0.0.1:8088/v1` 只是配置值，你需要自行提供可用的 Embedding 服务。
3. 选择**自动记忆**并保存，重启 DSH 使记忆管线配置生效。
4. 对话后可让 Agent 搜索记忆，或检查插件日志确认提取和工具注册情况。

| 模式 | 捕获 | 提取 | 自动召回 | 搜索工具 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 自动记忆 | 开 | 开 | 开 | 开 |
| 仅搜索已有记忆 | 关 | 关 | 关 | 开 |
| 暂停记忆功能 | 关 | 关 | 关 | 关 |

高级设置可单独调整开关、存储位置和调优参数；已有混合配置显示为自定义组合，不会自动覆盖。搜索工具开关可即时生效，其他管线配置按提示重启。表单只写入编辑过的字段，未修改的密钥保留。

dsh-tdai-memory README · 使用说明：- 提取模型需要稳定输出结构化结果；提取在后台进行，耗时和质量取决于模型与服务。
- 默认关闭 LLM 去重。默认 Embedding 使用本地 OpenAI 兼容端点；远程兼容端点不需要 `node-llama-cpp`。若选择完全本地的 Embedding 后端，需要在目标 Profile 另行安装并批准可选的 `node-llama-cpp` 构建。
- 搜索工具缺失时，确认工具开关已开启，并检查 `[tdai-memory] tools registered` 日志。语言跟随 DSH。
- 捕获的对话和记忆会保存在本机；提取与 Embedding 请求会发送到你配置的服务，请自行选择合适的端点并备份数据。

dsh-tdai-memory README · DSH TDAI Memory：[简体中文](README.md) | English

Bring TencentDB Agent Memory's layered memory system to [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness): capture conversations, extract structured memories and retrieve relevant context in later conversations. This project adapts the original OpenClaw plugin's core to DSH.

dsh-tdai-memory README · Features：| Layer | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| L0 | Capture raw conversations for later search |
| L1 | Use an extraction model to organize facts, preferences and events |
| L2 / L3 | Produce scene information and a user profile |
| Recall and search | Retrieve relevant memory for the current message; expose `tdai_memory_search` and `tdai_conversation_search` |

dsh-tdai-memory README · Features：Data defaults to `~/.memory-tencentdb/memory-tdai`, allowing existing data in that directory to be reused. Capture, extraction and recall depend on enabled settings, model connections and retrieval results; saving or recalling every detail is not guaranteed.

dsh-tdai-memory README · Compatibility and installation：Supports DSH Web / Desktop. The repository declares compatibility with `0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.1` / `rc.2` / `rc.3` / `rc.4` / `rc.5` and versions matching `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0`; see [package.json](package.json) for the complete prerelease range. Node.js `>=22.18` is required.

For Desktop, install its `dsh` command through **Application → Manage dsh Command** first:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-tdai-memory
```

dsh-tdai-memory README · Compatibility and installation：Replace `desktop` with `web` for Web. Restart DSH and open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-tdai-memory**. You can also install it through the [Enhancement Suite](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-enhancement-suite).

dsh-tdai-memory README · Quick setup：1. Configure an **OpenAI-compatible LLM address, model and key** for memory extraction.
2. Configure an **OpenAI-compatible embedding address, model and dimensions**. The default `http://127.0.0.1:8088/v1` is a configuration value, not an included service; provide a working embedding service yourself.
3. Select **Automatic memory**, save and restart DSH to apply pipeline changes.
4. After a conversation, ask the Agent to search memory or check the plugin logs for extraction and tool registration.

dsh-tdai-memory README · Quick setup：| Mode | Capture | Extraction | Automatic recall | Search tools |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Automatic memory | On | On | On | On |
| Search existing memory only | Off | Off | Off | On |
| Pause memory features | Off | Off | Off | Off |

dsh-tdai-memory README · Quick setup：Advanced settings expose individual switches, storage location and tuning. Existing mixed settings appear as a custom combination and are not overwritten automatically. The search-tool switch applies immediately; restart as prompted for other pipeline changes. The form writes edited fields only and retains unchanged keys.

dsh-tdai-memory README · Usage notes：- The extraction model needs to produce reliable structured output. Extraction runs in the background; latency and quality depend on the model and service.
- LLM deduplication is off by default. The default embedding configuration points to a local OpenAI-compatible endpoint; remote compatible endpoints do not require `node-llama-cpp`. For the fully local embedding backend, install and approve the optional `node-llama-cpp` build in the target profile separately.
- If search tools are missing, check that they are enabled and look for `[tdai-memory] tools registered` in the logs. The interface follows the DSH language setting.
- Captured conversations and memories are stored locally; extraction and embedding requests go to your configured services. Choose appropriate endpoints and back up your data.

dsh-tdai-memory README · Development, attribution and feedback：- The [historical detailed documentation](https://github.com/Scorp1o117/dsh-tdai-memory/blob/7e1dd9c9b1214f5fc531f560296e492af204c4e1/README.md) preserves architecture, configuration examples and older notes; its install commands and compatibility information may be outdated.
